channel.title: HackerOne — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by HackerOne (hackerone).

item.title: CVE-2025-64394 · 4.3 MEDIUM
item.description: A vulnerability allowing a low-privileged local user to write arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges during the installation of Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365, which can lead to privilege escalation or denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-108141 · 5.9 MEDIUM
item.description: A vulnerability allowing an authenticated user with the Restore Operator role, who also controls the contents of a backed-up NAS share, to write attacker-controlled files to an arbitrary path on the backup server through relative path traversal.

item.title: CVE-2026-106078 · 6.9 MEDIUM
item.description: A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass REST API authentication with a forged federation token and receive responses from REST API endpoints that do not call the Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 backup service.

item.title: CVE-2026-107671 · 8.5 HIGH
item.description: A vulnerability allowing an attacker with valid Administrator credentials to bypass multi-factor authentication by disabling it globally before completing MFA verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-108142 · 9.1 CRITICAL
item.description: A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authorization on the CDP Coordinator Service.
